company.shortDescription: Diode Computers designs and manufactures custom circuit boards on integrating artificial intelligence into the development process.
company.description: Diode Computers designs and manufactures custom circuit boards with a focus on integrating artificial intelligence into the development process. The company provides services from the initial design phase through to volume production. It utilizes a toolchain that includes open-source software like the PCB Compiler and Spec Generator, enabling rapid circuit board design and compatibility with traditional EDA tools such as KiCad and Altium. Diode Computers also offers real-time feedback on component costs and availability, helping businesses optimize their designs. The AI-driven process reduces development time for applications in industries such as robotics, aerospace, and edge computing.
